decisions.title: benchmark band — surface split
decisions.rule: Pre-transactional surfaces (public listing, browse, buyer preview) render no band. Seller-only in the listing pricing step and while a quote is in Drafting. Symmetric to both parties once a quote is issued. Below k, withheld from both parties, never from the buyer alone.

decisions.title: spec posture — pre-commit, defer effect
decisions.rule: The seller elects a normal posture from the existing closed vocabulary; the signed instrument states that the grant takes effect on — or ends on — a named trigger. Effective moment is a property of the instrument, never a fifth posture. D-07 stays closed.
